name: Claude How To
short: A guided course for Claude Code with diagrams and copy-paste templates, from slash commands to hooks, MCP, subagents and plugins.
what: This is a tutorial for Claude Code in 10 modules: slash commands, memory, checkpoints, the CLI, skills, hooks, MCP, subagents, advanced features and plugins. Each module has Mermaid diagrams and ready-made files you copy into your project. It includes a self-assessment and quizzes you run inside Claude Code.
who: People who have installed Claude Code and want to learn the features in order. The full path takes 11 to 13 hours. Skip it if you use a different coding agent, since everything here is for Claude Code.
needs: For the MCP example, a GitHub personal access token

steps.title: Add your first slash command
steps.text: Replace the path with your own project. Then type `/optimize` in Claude Code.

steps.title: Follow the path
steps.text: LEARNING-ROADMAP.md lists the modules in order with time estimates. Run `/lesson-quiz` with a topic after each one.

try.label: From the README
try.text: Run `/self-assessment` to find your level and get a personal roadmap.

watch: The hook examples are shell scripts copied into `~/.claude/hooks` and made executable. Read them before you install them.
The MCP example puts a GitHub personal access token in a request header.
It's a guide for one product. Everything assumes Claude Code.
